title: Staff password and MFA FAQ
brief: The IT team at Cinder Valley School District needs a FAQ page about the new staff password and multi-factor authentication policy that takes effect on 2026-11-03. Open with a two-sentence intro, then a warning callout near the top: IT will never ask for your password or your code by email or phone. Then the questions as headings, each with a short answer: "Why are we changing the policy?" (two phishing incidents in 2026 compromised staff mailboxes); "What changes on November 3?" (passwords must be at least 14 characters, and every staff account needs multi-factor authentication); "Do I have to change my password every 90 days?" (no, we are removing forced rotation and will only ask for a change after a suspected compromise); "What if I do not have a smartphone?" (the help desk will issue a hardware key at no cost); "What if I lose my phone or key?" (call the help desk at extension 4400 to get a temporary bypass code valid for 24 hours); "Who do I contact for help?" (the help desk, open 07:00 to 17:00 on school days). Plain text, headings and short lists only.

sections: Why are we changing the policy
What if I do not have a smartphone
Who do I contact for help

edit.request: Change the help desk extension to 4410, and add a question "Can I use the same password on other sites?" answered with a short no and the reason.
